notes:
### Fixed
- Rendering a large model no longer freezes SketchUp ("Not Responding"). The
  model is prepared in the background in small steps, with "Preparing the
  model n%" in the Render tab; you can keep working or cancel.

### Changed
- Rendering the same model again (only the camera or the sun moved) reuses
  the prepared model and starts at once. Any edit, undo or change of visible
  tags prepares it again.
- Live view on a large model (one that takes more than 5 seconds to prepare)
  no longer re-prepares it after every edit: press "Update model" when ready.
